name: game-editor-state
goal: Editor-only changes preserve running game state in both dimensions; only explicit reset clears progress

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Codex integration initialized both loaded documents and ordinary edits with createRun; editing checkpoint metadata discarded previously completed checkpoints.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Both dimension scenarios previously ended at the outcome. The shared scenario now crosses Checkpoints and returns to Preview after a metadata edit, asserting progress ownership.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: HARNESS_DESKTOP_TEST_PORT=5847 bun run --cwd packages/desktop test:e2e game-authoring.spec.ts -g "2d preview executes" failed: expected 3 of 4, received 0 of 4. /tmp/harness-game-edit-reset-red.log

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Initialize only when loading/resetting, preserve authoring edits, and enforce the cross-tab state contract in both existing dimension scenarios and normal root browser checks.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Removed createRun from ordinary edits; view transitions scope checkpoint progress independently and preserve shared mechanics state. Acceptance spec records the lifecycle gate.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Both dimension scenarios pass unchanged in /tmp/harness-game-ui-verified.log; seven game authoring browser scenarios passed with no unexpected console errors.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The same 2D scenario failed against the isolated pre-repair fixture in /Users/danielfugere/projects/harness-game-no-webgl-red: expected 3, received 0 (/tmp/harness-game-edit-guard-red.log). Repaired workspace passes.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: Root check and all package checks exercised; game lifecycle regressions and isolated red guard proven. Engine full check, 17 host/remote compatibility tests and all eight game browser scenarios pass; fresh screenshots inspected. Native Electron broader acceptance is separately pending on locked macOS.
